title: demo-ci-fix-drift
goal: Demo-only. Produce a deliberately failing run whose business outcome is independently verified and whose only defect is an unresolved trailing action selector, so the manager-facing CI-to-local-fix demo has a real, repair-eligible input. This plan never qualifies anything.

scenarios.description: A user adds a todo from the native page and the app commits it, but a trailing demo action addresses a control the app does not expose.

risks: This flow is demo-only and is intended to fail. The trailing action deliberately addresses an AutomationId the app does not expose.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The added todo is committed to the app's durable ledger, not merely rendered in the list.

independentBusinessOracles.description: Read the app's private todo ledger over adb and confirm it holds the exact record for the todo the flow added, and no removal. The ledger is written by the domain layer and read by no page, so this evidence is produced outside the UI the flow drove.
